description:
As an MLOps engineer, I need to ensure the integrity of my experiment artifact files by creating and verifying their SHA256 checksums. Inside the directory /home/user/experiments/exp42/, you will find a file named model.bin. Please perform the following steps: 1. Generate the SHA256 checksum of /home/user/experiments/exp42/model.bin. 2. Save the output in a file named /home/user/experiments/exp42/model.bin.sha256. 3. Verify the checksum using the .sha256 file and create a log of the verification result. The log file should be named /home/user/experiments/exp42/checksum_verification.log, and MUST contain exactly one line with either:
  • model.bin: OK
  • or
  • model.bin: FAILED
depending on the verification result. Organize the work in a way that I can inspect all three files (model.bin, model.bin.sha256, and checksum_verification.log) for evidence of a correct checksum process.
